(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles, wherein said cavity-generating particles are particles having an average size in the range of 8-12 microns; a thermally conductive binder that is a premixed solder paste; and a solvent, wherein the solvent comprises ethyl alcohol.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to a surface of an electronic component that is a silicon chip.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the surface of the electronic component by vaporization facilitated upon heating the surface.
